channelTitle: New moms have been doing this in the fridge for generations
hook: Ever wonder why some new moms keep a head of cabbage in the fridge that isn't for coleslaw? Grandma June knows exactly why.
remedy: Chilled cabbage leaves placed inside the bra are an old home remedy new mothers have used for generations to ease the discomfort of breast engorgement during breastfeeding.
steps: Chill whole cabbage leaves in the fridge
Rinse and pat dry, then gently shape a leaf to fit
Wear inside a bra for fifteen to twenty minutes, replacing with a fresh cool leaf as needed
caution: Remove leaves once swelling improves, since prolonged use is sometimes linked to reduced milk supply - talk with a lactation consultant or doctor for ongoing engorgement.
cta: New moms, has anyone actually tried this one? Let Grandma June know how it went.
